objectives_fil: Itugma ang walong kathang-isip na exposure sa posibleng paraan ng pagkalat at magmungkahi ng kontrol nang walang diagnosis.
Sa sitwasyon ng BHS, magmungkahi ng kontrol sa pinagmulan, kapaligiran, gawain at PPE na may tamang responsable.
Sa return demonstration, piliin ang angkop na paraan at ipakita ang kumpletong paglilinis ng magkabilang kamay kasama ang tamang pagpapatuyo.
Ipakita ang pagtakip ng ubo, tamang pagtatapon at hand hygiene, saka ipaliwanag ang pag-uulat sa BHS nang may respeto.
Sa household scene, tukuyin ang panganib sa pagkain, tubig at sanitasyon at magkasundo sa ligtas na pagbabago at dapat ipakumpirma.
Punan ang policy at training checklist ng BHS: lokasyon, bersiyon, responsable, tungkulin at kulang na training.
Itala ang isang IPC gap, agarang pag-uulat, responsable, petsa at ebidensiya ng follow-up nang walang imbentong resulta.
objectives_en: Match eight fictional exposures to possible transmission routes and propose a control without diagnosing anyone.
For a BHS scenario, propose source, environmental, work-practice and PPE controls with appropriate owners.
In a return demonstration, choose the appropriate method and show complete cleaning of both hands, including correct drying.
Demonstrate cough covering, disposal and hand hygiene, then explain respectful symptom reporting at the BHS.
In a household scene, identify food, water and sanitation risks and agree on safe improvements and points needing confirmation.
Complete a BHS policy and training checklist with location, version, owner, role and training gaps.
Record one IPC gap, prompt reporting, an owner, date and follow-up evidence without inventing results.
summary_fil: Kilalanin ang exposure, magsanay ng pag-iwas at sundin ang IPC process ng BHS.
summary_en: Recognize exposure, practise prevention and follow the BHS IPC process.
